summary: Verified all 5 desktop/mobile UI fixes requested. (1) Duplicate rendering on Support/Profile — FIXED: switching between every sidebar tab (Home, Sites, Reports, Support, Profile) shows ONLY the active screen's root testID visible; dashboard-scroll/sites-desktop/reports-desktop/support-header/profile-header are mutually exclusive on desktop (verified across 8 tab switches + scroll-to-bottom on Support and Profile). (2) Sidebar docking at 1440x700 and 1280x620 — PASS: sidebar-bottom bounding box docks within 12px of sidebar bottom (688/700 and 608/620), does not overlap sidebar-settings nav row, fully visible within viewport, user email truncated by numberOfLines=1. (3) Quotes pager — PASS: quotes-pager shows 'Showing 1–10 of 15' with 10 rows on page 1; quotes-pager-next shows 'Showing 11–15 of 15' with 5 rows on page 2; quotes-pager-prev returns to page 1; pager.bottom (971) sits inside table.bottom (972) — 1px rounding, inside the table border. (4) Sites filter row — PASS visually and via code review: sites-filter-row contains BusinessSwitcherChip (hidden when businesses<=1), sites-search and sites-add-new on the same top (0px diff). Note: the test account actually has 2 businesses on the live backend (chip renders 'All businesses (2)'); 0 sites so sites-export is correctly hidden (DOM absent). (5) Mobile 390x844 — PASS: desktop-sidebar absent, bottom tab bar renders [Home, Sites, Reports, Support, Profile] with role=tab, tapping Support navigates to /support and renders Support screen, tapping Profile navigates to /profile and renders Profile screen (Email alerts list present). Minor React Native-Web warnings only (shadow* deprecated, pointerEvents deprecated, useNativeDriver fallback) — pre-existing, not blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warnings in console: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow); props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents); useNativeDriver falling back to JS animation. Pre-existing, not caused by this iteration. Reference: console logs across all screens.

action_items: Optional cleanup: migrate remaining shadow* style props to boxShadow and move pointerEvents into style={} to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
No functional issues from this iteration — all 4 reported desktop bugs plus mobile regression are resolved.
critical_code_review_comments: portal-shell.tsx sidebar: flex container with ScrollView (sideTop flex:1 minHeight:0) + sideBottom flexShrink:0 is the correct pattern for docking at short heights — verified at 620px.
ui.tsx Pager is rendered as the last child of <Table>, so the bottom border of the table encloses the pager row (verified visually: pager.bottom==table.bottom within 1px rounding).

(tabs)/_layout.tsx uses screenOptions callback with navigation.isFocused() to apply sceneStyle:{display:'none'} only on desktop — correct scoping; mobile is unaffected and tabs still animate normally.
